fact: From 10 to 21 April 2023 MINUSMA coordinated the installation of the UNODC goCASE investigative file management software at the headquarters of the Special Investigations Brigade (BIS) of the PJS, and 12 BIS staff were trained on it.
title: Combating Terrorism, International Crime and Transnational Organized Crime: A Special Judicial Unit Deploys Criminal Analysis Software
